text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":30,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"30 marbles"},{"id":"q2","value":1,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1/5"},{"id":"q3","value":5,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1/5"},{"id":"q4","value":10,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"gives 10 to Donald"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"divide total marbles (30) by 5 to find how many marbles Dean gives to Jamie (one fifth)"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"subtract marbles given to Jamie from the total to find what remains after Jamie share"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract the 10 marbles given to Donald to find how many marbles are left for Dean"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"marbles left for Dean"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"numerator of the fraction 1/5; multiplying by 1 is the identity, so only the denominator (5) is needed to find one fifth via division"}]}
